title: Household comparison gaps and the first three earned campaign route receipts

reviews.classification: historical implementation / evidence scope / later continuation
reviews.disposition:
Historical matrix and frozen-candidate evidence under AD36/AD42/AD43. Preserve F1–F7 as separately scoped findings: recipe navigation, same-context equipment comparison, actual learning seams, finite batches and palette routines already had suppliers. Missing natural acquisition/browser coverage does not erase those implementations. Mountain action requirements/failures differ from the remaining spatial wet-rock scene, authored creature, permanent-food reward and learned attack view. No compatible universal food/slime law was established. The bounded cat preference/history work does not establish hair growth, house restoration or a rumor network. Native rest, hearth, firewood, adoption and other local-life routes predated this follow-up.

The final household candidate is frozen to the stated bundle and 736-input manifest, excluding concurrent startup differences. Its six native checks use synthetic home/custody access; they do not prove natural household acquisition. Same-clock repeated play, cloth retention, warmth/smoke, known-only history, stable focus, A/B home gestures and literal import are useful distinct checks. The final frozen 2394/2394 run supersedes the incomplete frozen setup after restoring its test dependencies; the terminated live startup run and its hidden-selector regression remain separate. Earlier 2394 runs are not added as extra tests. Final focused 16/16 follows the disclosure refinement rather than every earlier 23 assertion being rerun unchanged. Current desktop floor evidence includes 1536, not mobile.

D1–D3 completion applies to the referenced report's bounded household candidate, not all seven future-world examples or deep-engine P4. Ownership releases, allowance percentages, PIDs and the preview address are dated records, not current process or write-ownership proof. Human play/feel remains optional review under AD42, separate from unmet content scope. This reconciliation read the complete checkpoint without inspecting the frozen artifact, linked reports, source, test logs or server today.

reviews.classification: historical implementation / evidence scope / later continuation
reviews.disposition:
Historical implementation and bounded floor evidence under AD36/AD42/AD43. The final 16-stage fresh route, exact rebuilt fingerprint, actual 14/21 px desktop inspection and literal import support the original KJ1 floor claim at the recorded input identity. Earlier MCP sampling precedes the dawn correction and does not substitute for the final route. Focused counts overlap and are not an aggregate full-suite count. Authored timings and lower-bound purse/portion allocations remain separate from source-qualified facts and a complete starting inventory.

Preserve the concrete repaired seam: settlement reads authoritative elapsed time rather than an unavailable UI local-hour fact; native completion-ledger progress avoids a parallel saved quest counter. Participant reservation/co-location remains actual admission rather than a prose promise. Foreign Village offers were gated at their producer, without deleting historical offworld instances or claiming all provenance was fixed. Regeneration metadata retention and rejected lost stages remain separate from gameplay route proof. Notebook/report erasure does not undo an action or reset the completion ledger.

The shopping continuation marked unplayable here is an earlier boundary subsequently covered by the KJ2 receipt, not a current whole-campaign stop. Sixteen aggregated authored stages do not establish every source sentence as a choice, autonomous NPC lives, alternate conversations or combat completion. The old preview/PID is not a live-service or installation claim. Current content review adds no source reading, current runtime validation, artifact inspection or human acceptance; private source and test-save evidence remain private.

reviews.classification: historical implementation / evidence scope / later continuation
reviews.disposition:
Historical multi-build route evidence and remaining integration under AD36/AD42/AD43. The 18-stage continuation follows 16 household stages; the completed 34-stage ledger is not evidence of a single uninterrupted fresh route on the final delivery bundle. Preserve three identities: the fresh-prefix/consumer build, observer/Notebook correction build, and final menu/presentation delivery build. Earned post-hall/completion fixtures establish their stated checks, not ordinary first-time acquisition or manual pacing. Developer menu visibility is a tested policy distinction; proposed ordinary/random starts remain separate.

Actual purse/stock, placed loaves, travel, participant support, attributed conversation and native pending terms differ from a completed promised exchange, remote original item physics or universal upkeep. Physical anchoring, inactive representations, controller links and original actors must not be collapsed into cloned people or inventory. Authored action/travel timing and aggregate vegetables remain fills. The recorded source budget includes reused audits/repair exposure; it does not establish a new full read of chapters 7/8 or the whole novel in this reconciliation. The later ch8 aftermath stays outside the lead's knowledge.

Preserve the concrete TD8–TD9 integration gaps: native resource stock and placed custody are not identified sidebar food/items; food use and combat custody need conservation. Unknown ritual cost is unknown, not zero. Paused clock stepping leaves ordinary manual cadence unverified. The in-flight and returned persistence cases do not prove every alternate seed/branch or offscreen life. Focused counts and historical shared housing-link diagnostics remain at their recorded inputs; no current failing link or full-tree green is inferred. Human review is optional under AD42. Private pack/test checkpoints, old preview server and uncommitted state are not current runtime, installation or publication proof.

reviews.classification: historical implementation / evidence scope / later continuation
reviews.disposition:
Historical source-window implementation and PF13 comparison under AD36/AD42/AD43. Eleven intents cover the recorded ch16–17 window, not the contract or acceptance of employment. Invitation, private resolve, referral and assent stay distinct. The seven-pence pocket reconstruction follows the explicit four-paid/three-left source basis, while the conflicting earlier five-pence statement remains unresolved. The explicit count action and native fare cost differ from an unexplained purse top-up or an invented payee. Nap duration is authored. Display-name corrections reuse actual bodies and places rather than creating new identities.

Duplicate flat/pub IDs and incomplete actor routines explain the recorded arrival-placement/visit-hold workaround, not a general valid schedule. KJ3E's qualified freeze row supersedes its own earlier two-actor explanation: some two-actor relocations passed, the specific combination froze, and the cause was undetermined. KJ3H's later conservative one-relocation workaround does not establish that actor count caused the defect. Household testimony differs from private reasoning; the deferred affinity meter does not remove relationship consequences that actual consumers can support.

The fresh origin used an earned KJ3D seed, and the successful route is split at an earned checkpoint after host-load stalls. Preserve that split, the zero-page-error scope of the resumed run and the uninspected 14 px capture versus inspected 21 px capture. Literal import, two fare counterfactuals and unchanged bundle bytes do not establish civil-clock alignment, absent-speaker/cancel behavior or human cadence. Four hours and runner/probe counts under swapping are diagnostics, not a controlled sweep speedup. Later KJ3F/G/H receipts cover the dated next boundaries with their own limits; this record grants no new build/reader/worker dispatch. No current source, pack, browser or private test-save inspection occurred here.
